selection_rule: Consume all four previously missing nonprotected nonquarantined calendar years identified by R11 (2014,2016,2018,2019) as one fixed batch; no adaptive stopping or year substitution after any source/outcome inspection.
expected_week_probe: 1..53; file presence determined mechanically, missing week allowed only as typed source absence
aggregation: UTC-aligned complete 15-minute bins from M1 BidOpen/BidHigh/BidLow/BidClose; incomplete bins dropped; preserve gap-break/segment accounting identical to ORG1 GFRESH source binding
support_threshold: 100 uncensored opportunities AND 20 exact joint events across >=2 populations before any probability fit may be considered
